full_title: Master Weaver & Kind-Hearted Village Elder of Pythonia

demographics.proportions: ~156 cm tall (4.9 heads tall — taller than Hero Kai at ~142 cm and Iron Outpost Blacksmith at ~150 cm, reaching Great Wizard's shoulder height at ~180 cm)
demographics.build: Warm, sturdy, kind grandmotherly frame with gentle rounded shoulders

facial_features.face_shape: Round, warm friendly face with soft rosy blush across cheeks, gentle brow lines, and warm smile lines around eyes
facial_features.skin_tone: Warm fair peach skin with soft rosy coral cheeks

hair.style: Soft wavy hair parted near center, swept gently back and coiled into a neat low bun at the nape of her neck

eyes.shape: Wide open friendly rounded eyes with warm arched dusty-grey eyebrows
eyes.highlights: Crisp white storybook catchlights conveying warmth and curiosity

facial_features.nose_mouth_and_ears: Cozy rounded nose, warm open grandmotherly smile, small round copper-brown wooden stud earrings (#8E5B3E)

weaver_workshop_apron.name: Weaver Workshop Apron Dress (Canonical Default)
weaver_workshop_apron.description: Grandma Looma's cozy everyday artisan outfit worn at her wooden loom in Loom Forest

blouse.color: Warm ochre-gold / honey amber long-sleeved tunic blouse (Hex: #C9965B)
blouse.pattern: Scattered folk botanical leaf and petal prints in terracotta red (#9B4A38), sage green (#5A7A58), and slate teal (#4C6B6E)
blouse.collar: Small V-notch neckline framed by an embroidered sage-green geometric zigzag border

bodice_and_skirt.color: Muted olive-brown / earth-taupe sleeveless vest over matching gathered ankle-length skirt (Hex: #7B6B4F)

apron.color: Clean warm cream / off-white linen bib apron (Hex: #EDE4CE)
apron.detail: Wide front bib tying neatly with fabric straps in a bow behind her waist

eyewear.style: Small round thin wire-framed reading glasses (Hex: #555A5E)
eyewear.detail: Suspended on a thin tan leather cord around her neck resting against the upper chest of her apron (worn perched on nose when inspecting fine weave drafts)

weaver_workshop_apron.footwear: Sturdy dark brown leather buttoned village shoes (#4E3728) with cream wool socks

props.primary_tool: Smooth oval carved hardwood boat-shaped weaving shuttle (#8D5C34) wound with colorful yarn bobbin
props.textile: Vibrant striped & geometric handwoven Pythonia cloth (coral red, teal, cream, sage green, mustard gold)
props.workshop_lantern: Hanging rustic bronze/copper oil lantern casting warm amber light (#F6B74B)

village_market_shawl.name: Village Market Shawl & Basket Attire
village_market_shawl.description: Outdoor travel variant layering a cozy terracotta-and-olive handwoven fringed wool shoulder shawl fastened with a brass pin over her ochre floral blouse and cream apron, carrying a wicker yarn basket

winter_tea_cardigan.name: Storytelling Winter Cardigan & Tea Attire
winter_tea_cardigan.description: Evening indoors variant layering a chunky knitted sage-green shawl cardigan over her patterned blouse with spectacles perched on her nose while holding a warm teacup

art_style_dna.primary_style: Hand-drawn fantasy storybook illustration, Studio Ghibli meets Akira Toriyama Dragon Quest art style (harmonious with Hero Kai & Great Wizard)
art_style_dna.line_art: Clean warm-sepia and dark charcoal ink linework (#3E2B23) with organic hand-drawn lineweight variation
art_style_dna.shading_technique: Soft watercolor and painterly gouache washes on subtle antique parchment texture (#FAF4E8)
art_style_dna.color_palette: Ochre honey-gold (#C9965B), olive-brown (#7B6B4F), cream linen (#EDE4CE), dusty ash-silver (#A89F8D), terracotta leaf (#9B4A38), sage green (#5A7A58), hardwood brown (#8D5C34), warm lantern amber (#F6B74B)
art_style_dna.atmosphere: Cozy, nurturing, wise, tactile artisanal craft, heartwarming

do: Always include her wavy dusty silver-ash hair parted in center and pulled into a low bun at the nape of her neck
Always render the small round reading glasses hanging on a tan cord necklace over her cream apron chest (or worn on her nose when crafting)
Always feature her ochre botanical leaf-printed blouse with the sage-green zigzag V-neck border under her olive-brown vest and cream bib apron
Always include her carved hardwood boat-shaped weaving shuttle or handwoven colorful striped Pythonia textiles when in workshop/story scenes
Maintain exact Studio Ghibli x Dragon Quest sepia-ink and watercolor style matching Hero Kai and Great Wizard
dont: Do NOT render her in modern glasses, modern aprons, or photorealistic 3D CGI
Do NOT change her dusty ash-silver hair bun into loose waist-length hair or bright neon dye
Do NOT omit the reading glasses on a neck cord or the sage zigzag embroidery on her blouse neckline
Do NOT replace her carved wooden boat shuttle with glowing futuristic sci-fi gadgets
